name: pii-challenge-attestation
description:
Spec-054 FR-013a/FR-014 — challenge/attestation flow.

The merchant has computed `expected_hmac_hex` over `pii:buyer_email:audit@example.com` under `key_version=1` using the stub HMAC algorithm from vector 008. The auditor presents `candidate_value` and `expected_hmac_hex` to the merchant attestation service. The merchant computes the candidate digest, finds it matches, and signs an attestation with the merchant root key whose public JWK is published in `jwks_snapshot`.

Conformance runners MUST invoke `verifyPiiAttestation({ attestationJws, jwks: jwks_snapshot })` from `@agenticmcpstores/trust-receipt-verifier` and assert:

  - `result.valid === true`
  - `result.matches === true`
  - `result.candidateDigest === expected_hmac_hex`
  - `result.keyVersion === 1`

The Ed25519 private key behind `merchant-root-009` is intentionally NOT included — verifier conformance only requires the public JWK to validate the attestation signature.
